command: Replace the production matrix path's legacy CUSTOM_0/response adapter with descriptor sequencer -> gemmini_rocc_program_adapter -> retained RocketTile CUSTOM_3. Feed a frozen OS/WS/conv program, capture actual Gemmini busy assertion/deassertion, and prove ordered payloads plus one completion event. Reject invalid descriptor chains before the first RoCC commit. Do not tie off PTW/TileLink or use io_resp as generic completion. Use taskset -c 8-25, MemAvailable >10 GiB, at most -j4, and a memory cgroup.
success_condition: All required Gemmini L2 operations match their official C/RTL paths in retained RocketTile context with identical command/write/event traces and bit-exact outputs; upstream remains clean.
failure_policy: Stop at the first command/write/event divergence. Do not connect the clean-room adapter to the official macro, hand-write TileLink/PTW behavior, skip WS/conv/event coverage, relax numerical checks, or mark L2 PASS.
